messages:
paola: Quick heads-up — marketplace contact asked for pen-test report + SOC2 attestation to complete listing intake. They gave a hard deadline of Mon EOD for artifacts or a secure upload link. Can we own this? :eyes:

samir: I can assemble the raw artifacts (scan outputs, remediation log, pen-test report redacted). Need to know where to upload and who can sign off on redactions.

ben: We have a redacted pen-test PDF in the Vault at `vault://partners/marketplace/redacted-pen-test-2025.pdf`. Security needs to approve sharing to external partners.

ellen: Security here — we can produce an SOC2 summary letter + an attestation template. For the pen-test report we need to scrub PII and any partner IP. I can review redactions by Friday. Also FYI the marketplace questionnaire asks about KMS/HSM usage and data residency (see Q7/8).

paola: Good — thanks. Marketplace prefers presigned S3 links or the partner portal. They explicitly said they cannot accept unredacted raw reports. I'll ask for the portal option but we should prepare presigned links as fallback.

mike: For KMS config: we use customer-managed keys in us-east-1 for marketplace listings. I'll paste the snippet for the config we should include.

mike: ```
KMS: {
  keyAlias: "alias/redwood-marketplace",
  region: "us-east-1",
  rotation: true
}
```

samir: ETA to bundle artifacts if elllen approves redactions: 48 hours. I'll create tarball and a SHA256. Command I'll run:

samir: ```bash
tar czf marketplace-evidence.tar.gz /tmp/marketplace-evidence/
sha256sum marketplace-evidence.tar.gz > marketplace-evidence.tar.gz.sha256
aws s3 cp marketplace-evidence.tar.gz s3://redwood-partner-uploads/marketplace/ --acl private
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-uploads/marketplace/marketplace-evidence.tar.gz --expires-in 259200
```

security-bot: Automated vuln-scan complete for latest build — no critical findings. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)

ben: I'll request permission in the Vault to share that `vault://` object externally. Who should I add as approver? @ellen?

ellen: Yes, add me. Also assign paola as business owner so we capture the acceptance. I'll run a quick check for any partner IP blocks to remove.

paola: Action items I have so far:
- @ellen: review redactions + approve sharing (due Fri 10am)
- @samir: bundle artifacts, create presigned link and checksum (due Fri 3pm)
- @ben: request Vault share permissions and add approvers (ASAP)
- @mike: send KMS/HSM config snippets and docs for questionnaire answers (today)
- Me (paola): submit to marketplace portal and follow up on their confirmation (Mon if needed)

paola: If anyone hits blockers ping me here and I'll escalate to the marketplace PM. Thanks all :thumbsup:
